clientVouchersAskText: Hello, my voucher {code} could not be used. Could you issue a credit voucher?
clientVouchersBackCredit: Use it again here until {date}, or ask support for a credit voucher.
clientVouchersConsumedBody: You cancelled at {name} after confirming, so the voucher is used up.
clientVouchersCreditBody: Granted by Ghazal support. Claim it with any hall, hotel or service within {validity}, then confirm there within {confirm}.
clientVouchersCreditIssuedBody: Support issued you a credit voucher. It works at any hall, hotel or service.
clientVouchersExpiredBody: Not used before {date}, so it can no longer be used.
clientVouchersForfeitedBody: The {hours} to confirm at the venue or service ended, so this voucher is not valid and does not come back.
clientVouchersInfoWaiting: Waiting for {name} to reply. Your voucher stays with this request until it is answered.
clientVouchersInvalidSaving: On these changes the saving at the venue is smaller than the voucher price.
clientVouchersInvalidTarget: This voucher belongs to {bound}, and your request is now for {other}.
clientVouchersNoneBody: A voucher lets you request {name} at the voucher price. It costs {fee}, paid once, online.
clientVouchersPayBody: Pay {name} directly, on the terms you agreed. Their team scans the code, then marks it used.
clientVouchersPayingBody: We are waiting for the bank to confirm. The voucher is ready the moment it does.
clientVouchersQrAwake: The screen stays bright and awake while this is open.
clientVouchersQuoteLabel: The choice your voucher is bound to
clientVouchersReuseOnly: Support can issue a credit voucher only when the venue or service could not take your request. This voucher can be used again here.
clientVouchersTermBack: If the venue declines, does not reply or cancels, the voucher comes back: use it again here for {days}, or ask support for a credit voucher.
clientVouchersTermDirect: You pay {name} directly, outside the app, after you confirm. Ghazal takes no part in that payment.
clientVouchersTermForfeit: After approval, confirm within {confirm} by paying at the venue or service, or the voucher is not valid.
clientVouchersTermUsed: If you cancel after confirming, the voucher is used up.
clientVouchersTermValid: Valid for {validity} from the day you pay.
clientVouchersTermWhat: A {fee} voucher lets you request {name} at the voucher price. It belongs to this choice only.
clientVouchersTermWindows: {name} replies within {reply}. After approval you have {confirm} to confirm.
clientVouchersTermWithdraw: If you withdraw before approval, you can use it again here.
clientVouchersTooSmallBody: On this choice the voucher would not save you more than it costs, so we are not offering one. Contact the venue and pay the standard price.
clientVouchersUsedUpBody: You cancelled after confirming, so this voucher is used up.
clientVouchersWhySuspended: {name} is not taking requests at the moment.
clientVouchersWindowBody: The date is held until the window ends. After it, the approval ends and the voucher is not valid.
